sources: MDC GIS Discover_Nature/Area_Feature_Layers FeatureServer/27 (no camping point for area 8235) and /26 (14 lots), queried 2026-11-09
summary: DROP proposed (lot-only camping, no designated point): the brochure says 'Camping is allowed on or adjacent to all area parking lots'; MDC's GIS has no camping point for the area and the map has no camping symbol (legend: parking lot, privy, roads, ponds). The stored pin is just the lot nearest the area centre.
flags: DROP (lot-only, no designated point): brochure https://mdc.mo.gov/sites/default/files/2022-03/8235.pdf: 'Camping is allowed on or adjacent to all area parking lots. No unattended open campfires allowed. Groups of more than 10 campers require a special use permit. Stays are limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period.' and 'Walk-in/backpack camping is allowed EXCEPT during firearms deer and turkey seasons.' The page lists 'Camping: Open Camping-Walk/Float/Backpack (no Deer/Turkey), Designated Camping Sites', but GIS 27 holds no camping point for area 8235 and the 2021 map's legend has no camping symbol - only 14 parking lots (GIS 26). The stored pin is lot 921, chosen as 'the parking lot nearest the area centre'. Both 2026-11-09 drop cases apply (no designated point with only a lot to camp on; brochure permits camping at the parking lots).
If kept anyway: Rule 140 standard, no Rule 101; phone 'For more information call (660) 785-2420' matches stored; not waterfront; no horse camp.
